opportunity_owner: Every exact V18 basis_breadth admission; no new event, threshold, or outcome-selected subset.

layers.fast_onset: V18 raw-turn sentinel sequence: short_to_long propagation, long_to_short catch-up, mixed, or unresolved.
layers.medium_owner: Unchanged V18 6/12/24/48/96 completed-five-minute impulse and dominant-CL/matched-MCL transport router.
layers.slow_financing: One nested 24/48/96/192/384 completed-five-minute DirectionalImpulseEngine using V18's exact turn policy and thresholds. It resets only at contract identity and never sees a future bar.

slow_state_law.underwarm: not all five horizons ready, no trend state, or no causal state age
slow_state_law.new: ready state age is below the existing 24-bar maturation boundary
slow_state_law.mature: ready state age is at least the existing 24-bar maturation boundary

conflict_law.transport_financed: V18 executed direction agrees with ready slow direction
conflict_law.propagating_takeover: V18 direction opposes slow direction but the raw turn is a same-direction short_to_long wavefront
conflict_law.mature_counter_auction: V18 direction opposes a mature slow owner without a propagating takeover
conflict_law.unresolved_conflict: all remaining slow-opposed or underwarm cases

projected_profiles.mature_slow_route: only mature_counter_auction opportunities route to slow direction; all others retain V18
projected_profiles.mature_slow_hold: only mature_counter_auction opportunities abstain; all others retain V18

selection_law: Count both periods with all returns, MFE, MAE, and PnL sealed. Mature-slow route is primary and may proceed if it passes alone; mature-slow hold is retained only if it independently passes. The lifecycle also carries unchanged V18 control, discovery may select only a complete gate passer, and only that selection may expose validation.
prohibitions: no horizon, policy, maturity, sequence, time, ATR, slope, parity, basis, or state-age sweep
no category deletion, union search, continuous score, news authority, risk overlay, stop, target, timeout, quota, order, or capital authority
no validation economics during the census
